profile.visual_desc: Humanoid in layered navy robes with crimson trim and a dark green base. A deep blue hood obscures the face, leaving only glowing red eyes visible.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Extreme close-up of a shadowed face within a dark hood. Features piercing red slit eyes and a sharp, prominent nasal ridge.
profile.weapon_desc: A dark wooden staff with a silver hook-shaped head, held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Facing down-right, the unit stands with the staff held low. The left hand is raised in a curved gesture.
profile.step2_windup: Arms spread wide into a T-pose. Golden energy begins to flicker at the staff tip and left palm.
profile.step3_impact: Discharges a circular yellow energy ring from the left hand. The golden halo expands outward in a bright, thin arc.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the wide stance as the magical energy dissipates. The unit slowly lowers arms to transition back to neutral.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The yellow energy arc in Frame 4 correctly emanates from the extended left palm, forming a localized circular pulse.

evaluation.diagnosis: Sequence accurately scales original assets. Weapon positioning and VFX timing match reference frames. Facing and anatomy remain consistent.
